description: "Ocean Gardens: The History of the Marine Aquarium" by Henry Noel Humphreys is an informative account on marine aquariums written in the mid-19th century. The book delves into the establishment, preservation, and the fascinating history linked to marine aquariums, exploring the myriad forms of aquatic life that can be cultivated within them."  The opening of the work introduces the reader to the author’s perspective on the often overlooked beauty and mystery of the ocean, contrasting the mundane activities of seaside visitors with the vibrant, intricate life hidden beneath the waves.
